text: If this is the first time a product has been ordered from a supplier: Buyer makes arrangement with Manufacturer or Distributor (acting as Supplier) to supply the product. Buyer agrees with Supplier on payment terms (pay in advance, pay on delivery (COD), or credit (billing account) with net payment period). Buyer records initial supplier information for product with at least minimum and increment quantities and latest supplier cost (for a given quantity). Buyer may also record more detailed agreement information.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
